cohort: The study included 1186 consecutive pregnant women, aged 16-47 years (mean 26.9), who delivered between May 1 and December 1, 2022, at Mogadishu Somali Turkey Recep Tayyip Erdogan Training and Research Hospital.
finding: Maternal anaemia, particularly moderate and severe forms, is associated with increased risks for adverse maternal outcomes (e.g., postpartum haemorrhage, blood transfusions, placental abruption, ICU admission) and adverse foetal outcomes (e.g., preterm delivery, low birth weight, stillbirths).
